metadata.scoring_methodology: Empirical scoring 1-10 based on alignment with OECD/Treasury/Reserve Bank projections for stability, growth, and equality across 8 policy domains. Higher score = stronger evidence-based policy stance for that domain.

scoring_criteria.health: Adequacy of funding, access, wait-time reduction, mental health investment, preventative care alignment with WHO benchmarks
scoring_criteria.education: Evidence-based literacy/numeracy outcomes, infrastructure investment, teacher retention, ECE quality, NCEA coherence
scoring_criteria.crime_justice: Recidivism reduction, rehabilitation investment, police resourcing, youth justice efficacy (Justice Dept data)
scoring_criteria.housing_rental: Housing supply creation, affordability metrics, social housing targets, RMA efficiency
scoring_criteria.economy_col: Grocery competition, inflation management, fiscal sustainability, tax equity, OECD productivity alignment
scoring_criteria.employment: Job creation, wage growth above inflation, worker protections, benefit adequacy
scoring_criteria.transport_infra: Active/public transport investment, emissions reduction, regional connectivity
scoring_criteria.tiriti_maori: Constitutional honour of Te Tiriti, Maori health/education equity, self-determination provisions

score_rationale.health: Redirecting to frontline is positive but Pharmac funding flat in real terms; private delivery risk. Score 5.
score_rationale.education: Structured literacy evidence-based; teacher bonding scheme positive; but charter school expansion increases fragmentation. Score 6.
score_rationale.crime_justice: Three Strikes restoration contradicted by evidence on recidivism; gang legislation has some deterrent value. Score 5.
score_rationale.housing_rental: Going-for-housing-growth supply focus is evidence-aligned; 90-day no-cause eviction restoration reduces tenant security. Score 6.
score_rationale.economy_col: No new taxes maintains stability; grocery separation policy addresses duopoly; fiscal discipline sound. Score 6.
score_rationale.employment: No fair pay agreements reduces worker protections; wage growth tied to GDP growth forecast. Score 5.
score_rationale.transport_infra: Road-heavy; limited public transport investment; active transport deprioritised vs OECD sustainability norms. Score 4.
score_rationale.tiriti_maori: Abolished Maori Health Authority; limited Treaty commitments; reduced co-governance. Score 3.

key_policies.health: Frontline investment, hospital builds, local doctors/nurses, life-saving medicines
key_policies.education: Structured literacy/math, teacher bonding, school builds, screen-free ECE
key_policies.crime_justice: Three Strikes restored, 40% sentence discount cap, gang dispersal orders, Auckland transport police
key_policies.housing_rental: Going for Housing Growth, 5% first-home deposit, 90-day no-cause eviction, community housing providers
key_policies.economy_col: No new taxes, return to surplus 2028/29, grocery separation (New World/PAK'nSAVE), 2.7% GDP growth target
key_policies.employment: KiwiSaver enhancement, Back Pocket Boost for graduates, Apprenticeship pathways
key_policies.transport_infra: Road building focus, fast-track consenting, Auckland transport police
key_policies.tiriti_maori: Repealed Maori Health Authority, reduced co-governance, limited Treaty commitments

score_rationale.health: Free GP visits reduce ED overcrowding (evidence-strong); maternity/cervical screening expansions align with preventative care. Score 7.
score_rationale.education: Curriculum continuity; investment in ECE; but less specific on structured literacy vs National. Score 6.
score_rationale.crime_justice: Moderate rehabilitation focus; balanced sentencing; youth justice emphasis but limited police resourcing details. Score 5.
score_rationale.housing_rental: Social housing targets strong; CGT revenue helps fund; but housing supply delivery historically slow. Score 6.
score_rationale.economy_col: Targeted CGT evidence-based for equity; dual RB mandate positive for employment; $20 PT fare cap reduces cost of living. Score 6.
score_rationale.employment: Restoring dual RB mandate, Apprenticeship Boost, job creation focus. Score 7.
score_rationale.transport_infra: $20 weekly PT cap; multi-modal investment; rail integration. Score 7.
score_rationale.tiriti_maori: Mana Whakahono a Rohe restoration; active Treaty support; some co-governance willingness. Score 6.

key_policies.health: Free GP/prescriptions, free maternity scans, cervical screening, Family Doctor Loan Scheme
key_policies.education: ECE investment, curriculum continuity, teacher support
key_policies.housing_rental: Social housing build, CGT to fund services, affordability focus
key_policies.economy_col: Targeted CGT, return to surplus 2029/30, net debt ~20% GDP, Parliamentary Budget Office
key_policies.employment: Apprenticeship Boost, dual RB mandate restoration, job creation, emigration stemming
key_policies.transport_infra: $20 weekly PT fare cap, NZ Future Fund for infrastructure, rail+active transport
key_policies.tiriti_maori: Mana Whakahono a Rohe, Stand Up for Te Tiriti campaign, reclaim Maori seats

Green.full_name: Green Party of Aotearoa New Zealand

score_rationale.health: 10-year cross-party health plan commitment; preventative care investment; strong mental health focus. Score 7.
score_rationale.education: Progressive curriculum; but less structured literacy specificity. Score 6.
score_rationale.crime_justice: Rehabilitation-focused; restorative justice alignment with recidivism reduction evidence. Score 7.
score_rationale.housing_rental: LVT-adjacent policies address speculation; public housing investment; rent affordability focus. Score 7.
score_rationale.economy_col: Wealth tax on assets >$10M evidence-supported for redistribution; $10K tax-free threshold aids low income; grocery competition strong. Score 7.
score_rationale.employment: Worker protection focus, tax cuts for 96%, UBI adjacent. Score 7.
score_rationale.transport_infra: Intercity rail investment; active transport champion; climate-aligned. Score 9.
score_rationale.tiriti_maori: Tino rangatiratanga commitment; freshwater Maori rights; marae resourcing. Score 8.

key_policies.health: 10-year health plan, preventative care, primary care investment
key_policies.crime_justice: Restorative justice, rehabilitation, addressing root causes
key_policies.housing_rental: Affordable housing expansion, anti-speculation, public funding
key_policies.economy_col: 2.5% wealth tax on >$10M assets, inheritance tax, 45% top rate, $10K tax-free threshold, corporate tax increase
key_policies.employment: Tax cuts for 96%, worker protections, fair wages
key_policies.transport_infra: Auckland-Wellington overnight rail, Christchurch-Dunedin rail, active transport, climate transport
key_policies.tiriti_maori: Tino rangatiratanga over freshwater, marae resourcing, Te Waonui a Tane programme, Tiriti-based governance

score_rationale.employment: Worker protection rollback; smaller government reduces public sector jobs. Score 4.
score_rationale.transport_infra: Road focus, minimal active/public transport investment. Score 3.
